name: In an effort to get my two friends to date, I created a Magical Girl D&D campaign?!
source:
As if it wasn’t enough that the romantic tension between my two friends was hindering our magical girl group’s work, I also need to DM for our campaign! I’m going to use this DnD session to get them together if it isn’t the last thing that I do!

[from [url=https://azurecoffin.itch.io/magicalgirldndzoom]itch.io[/url]]
